targets: Raw daily recorded illness-onset counts, not a three-day moving average
path: Three future daily count predictions issued from the SAME ZIP and forecast origin
aggregation: Equal weight to all 585x28 ZIP-origin paths, then three horizons equally. Do not sum ZIPs before computing primary score.
direction: Sign of slope; endpoint-flat may include an interior peak or trough
shape: Exact match of BOTH consecutive daily change signs; endpoint slope cannot capture all shapes
forecast_protocol: Fixed March1-April29 2020 parameter-training interval; fit April30, May1-28 origins, no May labels for fitting. Predictors updated through origin.
feature_design: 34 candidates, ZIP FE; 24 identifiable slopes per horizon in this interval. Not a predictive selection experiment.
model_role: Dynamic Panel trajectory forecast is the benchmark output for subsequent models.
comparison_rule: Future models must match reference region IDs, forecast origins, horizon order and actual targets. Tune only using declared development data, never May evaluation scores.
limitations: Exploratory replay with later-developed definitions and retrospective onset counts. May covers mostly decline. No untouched-test or outbreak-warning claim.
